title: CLEARANCE! Orok Fire Sale
description: CLEARANCE! Orok Fire Sale — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Speak to 15 (more) Orok Scouts, 15 (more) Orok Warriors and 30 (more) Orok Spawns, then return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak to 15 (more) Orok Scouts, 15 (more) Orok Warriors and 30 (more) Orok Spawns, then return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

OK Dungeon Runner, you did a bang up job letting those Orok know they were violating the Fire Code. You really impressed me in coming back alive too! I'm getting some more complaints that even more Oroks came in to replace the ones you convinced to leave. It looks like you might want to head back into the Orok Outpost and have another polite discussion with them.

And by 'might' I mean 'have no choice but to'. Toodles!

Turn-in:

Has anyone ever told you you are a great public speaker? The Oroks definitely took notice.

If you want a chance to practice your speaking skills some more, let me know.

Objectives:

  • ''Speak'' with Orok Scouts
  • ''Speak'' with Orok Spawns
  • ''Speak'' with Orok Warriors

Client level range: 5–20
